Glad it's working. Two quick things to know before you rely on Final:

- **Duplicates won't reach Final until resolved.** Any row sharing an email with another row is flagged `DUP-email`, which makes it REVIEW. So even the latest copy stays out of Final until you remove or fix the extras in Raw and re-run.
- **Final may be nearly empty at first.** If most phones are 7 digits, like your sample, those rows will all be REVIEW. Set `DEFAULT_AREA_CODE` only if you're sure they're all local; otherwise you'll need to fill in area codes.

Otherwise, just add new park variants to ParkMap as they show up in REVIEW and re-run.
